Test Description: Validate PCIe1 SII Root Complex CSR defaults and masked write-readback behavior across the enumerated register list. Confirm that readable CSRs match specified reset values, and that writable bits reflect written test patterns while read-only bits remain at default.
Meta Test Description: program.c invokes chk_rst_val() and chk_rd_wr(). chk_rst_val(): iterates i in [0..CNT-1] over addr_array[153]; skips if read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000; also skips if addr_array[i]==mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL; reads data_rd=read_reg(addr) and compares to default_value_array[i]; increments def_fail_cnt on mismatch and logs; logs PASS on match. chk_rd_wr(): applies six patterns {0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0x00000000,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}. For each pattern, iterates i in [0..CNT-1]: skips writes if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0; else writes write_reg(addr,data_wr). For readback, skips if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0 or read_mask_array[i]==0; else reads data_rd=read_reg(addr) and computes wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff) and exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); compares data_rd to exp_val; increments wr_fail_cnt on mismatch and logs; logs PASS on match. test_case() calls both, then finish(1) if any failures, else finish(0). soft_reset_chk() exists but is not called.
Remarks: Registers with read_mask_array[i]==0 or write_mask_array[i]==0 are intentionally skipped. Addresses with skip_array[i]==1 are excluded from both write and readback. mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL is excluded from default-value verification. soft_reset_chk() is present but commented out in test flow.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Verify reset defaults: For each readable PCIe1 SII RC CSR in the test list (excluding SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL), read the register and confirm it matches the specified reset default. 2) Write-read validation with masks: For each of six standard data patterns, write to every writable CSR in the list (excluding addresses marked to skip). 3) Read back each writable and readable CSR and confirm that writable bits match the pattern while non-writable/read-only bits remain at their default values using the provided masks. 4) Record any mismatches; declare PASS only if no default mismatches and no write-read mismatches are found; otherwise declare FAIL.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: - test_case(): calls chk_rst_val(); chk_rd_wr(); if (def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0) finish(1); else finish(0). - chk_rst_val(): for (i=0..CNT-1) { addr=addr_array[i]; if (read_mask_array[i]==0) continue; if (addr_array[i]==mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); if (data_rd==default_value_array[i]) PASS log; else {def_fail_cnt++; FAIL log;} } - chk_rd_wr(): patterns chk_val[6]={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0x00000000,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}; for each pattern data_wr: (a) write phase: for (i=0..CNT-1) { addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0) continue; write_reg(addr, data_wr); } (b) read/compare phase: for (i=0..CNT-1) { addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd==exp_val) PASS log; else {wr_fail_cnt++; FAIL log;} }
Impacted Registers: All PCIe1 SII RC CSRs enumerated in addr_array[153], including examples mapped via RAG: SII_CFG_BAR0_START1; SII_PCIE1_CONTROLLER_INT_STS; SII_PCIE1_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPT_CONTROL; SII_MSI_CTRL_IO; SII_LTR_MSG; SII_PHY_CONTROL_0; SII_SOFT_RESET_CTRL; SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL. Full list per source addr_array in test_define.c.
Meta Impacted Registers: addr_array[153] entries such as: mizar_PCIE1_SII_CFG_BAR0_START1, mizar_PCIE1_SII_PCIE1_CONTROLLER_INT_STS, mizar_PCIE1_SII_PCIE1_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPT_CONTROL, mizar_PCIE1_SII_MSI_CTRL_IO, mizar_PCIE1_SII_LTR_MSG, mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_CONTROL_0, mizar_PCIE1_SII_SOFT_RESET_CTRL, mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL (see TestRepo/pcie/pcie1_sii_rc_reg_wr_rd_test/test_define.c).
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: - Reset defaults: Every readable CSR (excluding SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL) must read its specified default value. - Masked write-read: For each pattern, each CSR that is writable and readable must read back a value where writable bits equal the pattern and non-writable bits remain at default as determined by the masks. - Overall PASS when no mismatches are detected across all checks; otherwise FAIL.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Default check: if (data_rd == default_value_array[i]) PASS else {def_fail_cnt++; log "RST : Failed Default value mismatch"}. Write-read check: exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | ((write_mask_array[i]^0xffffffff) & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd == exp_val) PASS else {wr_fail_cnt++; log "Read_write : Failed : Write Read mismatch"}. Final: (def_fail_cnt==0 && wr_fail_cnt==0) → finish(0) PASS; else finish(1) FAIL.

Feature: Per-Function PCIe Capabilities and BAR Config
Test Description: Configure PCIe coherency control, wait for link-up via SII status, program PCIe configuration space (enable flags and BAR offsets), and verify completion via a handshake register. Coherency control uses DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF on both instances and link status is polled using the PCIE SII register at offset 0xC0 status.
Meta Test Description: program.c performs: (1) write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x0) to initialize a handshake/status register; (2) optional link training via compile-time paths DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP; (3) CACHE PROGRAMMING: repeatedly reads then sets bit fields with set_data(...) into DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for instance 0 and instance 1 in bit ranges [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22], writing back after each update; (4) wait_on(20), then consolidates the above field settings and writes back to both instances again; (5) polls SII0 status register at offset 0xC0 using read_sii0_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, optionally performs the same polling for SII1 when DM1_RC is enabled; (6) writes 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100; (7) optional DM0_RC path: mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); delay; reads first 10 config DWORDs via read_pcie_slv0_reg(i4); writes 0xFFFFFFFF to config offsets 0x10..0x24, reads them back and prints; writes specific values {0x0, 0x4, 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000} to 0x10..0x24 and reads back; enables Command register at 0x4 with 0x7; (8) optional DM1_RC path mirrors above using slv1 accessors; (9) waits, then polls read_reg(0xE6004100) until it equals 0x12345678; upon success, finish(0). There are no explicit failure exits; loops block until conditions are met.
Remarks: Behavior depends on compile-time macros DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP. Test requires link to reach status mask 0xD1 on SII status (offset 0xC0). Completion requires an external agent to set 0xE6004100 to 0x12345678; otherwise the test blocks.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize the test handshake register to 0x0 at address 0xE6004100. 2) Perform PCIe link training per the selected build configuration. 3) Program coherency settings by updating fields in DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIe instances, then re-apply consolidated settings after a short delay. 4) Poll the SII status at offset 0xC0 until link-up and required status bits are observed; repeat for the second instance if enabled. 5) Mark intermediate progress by writing 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100 and wait. 6) If PCIe instance 0 is enabled: set up memory base; read initial configuration DWORDs; probe BAR-related offsets by writing all-ones and reading back; program BAR offsets with specific values; enable Memory, IO, and Bus Master in the Command register. 7) If PCIe instance 1 is enabled: perform the same sequence as instance 0. 8) Wait briefly, then poll the handshake register at 0xE6004100 until it becomes 0x12345678 to confirm external completion. 9) Declare PASS when the handshake value is observed and end the test.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: - Initialize: write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x0). - Conditional link training: link_training_dm{0/1}_x4(4) or EP variants under DMx_RC/DMx_EP ifdefs. - Coherency programming: For each of {PCIE0, PCIE1}: rd = read_reg(DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF); rd = set_data(rd, 11, 14, 0xF); rd = set_data(rd, 3, 6, 0xF); write_reg(DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, rd); then similarly for ranges [27:30] and [19:22]; wait_on(20); re-read, set all four ranges, and write back. - Link status poll: data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); while ((data_rd & 0xD1) != 0xD1) { data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); } If DM1_RC, repeat with read_sii1_reg(0xC0). - Progress marker: write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x11111111); wait_on(15000). - RC0 config (if DM0_RC): mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); wait_on(10); for i=0..9: read_pcie_slv0_reg(i4); write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x10..0x24, 0xFFFFFFFF); read back 0x10..0x24; write specific values to 0x10..0x24 as {0x0,0x4,0x20000000,0x40000000,0x60000000,0x80000000}; read back each; write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7). - RC1 config (if DM1_RC): analogous sequence using read_pcie_slv1_reg/write_pcie_slv1_reg and mem_base_program_dm1_x4(). - Completion: wait_on(10); do { data_rd = read_reg(0xE6004100); wait_on(5); } while (data_rd != 0x12345678); finish(0).
Impacted Registers: DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF (instance 0); DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF (instance 1); PCIE SII register at offset 0xC0 status; PCIe configuration space offsets: 0x04, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24; Handshake/status register at 0xE6004100
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: PASS when: (a) SII status indicates required bits at offset 0xC0 for active instances; and (b) the handshake register at 0xE6004100 eventually reads 0x12345678, indicating external completion. The test is blocking until these conditions are met.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Link status loop: while ((read_sii{0,1}_reg(0xC0) & 0xD1) != 0xD1) continue; Completion loop: while (read_reg(0xE6004100) != 0x12345678) { wait_on(5); } On success, finish(0). No explicit error counter or finish(1) path implemented.
objectives: Validate PCIe link readiness via SII status, coherency control programming using DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, and configuration-space write/read access (enable flags and BAR offsets) with end-to-end completion signaled via a handshake register.
scope: Root Complex configuration on available PCIe instances as compiled; configuration-space access only; no payload data transfer validation.
assumptions: Build selects the active path via DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP; support functions (link training, mem_base_program, read/write helpers) are available; an external agent will write 0x12345678 to 0xE6004100.
preconditions: Hardware PCIe instances are powered and accessible; firmware has permissions for non-secure NIC configuration; link partners present for link training; DEBUG_DISPLAY optional for logs.

test_items.name: PCIe configuration programming and link status verification
test_items.description: Program coherency control, bring link to ready state, configure config-space offsets (enable flags and BARs), and verify overall completion using a handshake register.
steps: Initialize the handshake/status register at 0xE6004100 to 0x0.
Perform PCIe link training for enabled instances.
Program coherency control fields in DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for all enabled instances.
Poll the SII status at offset 0xC0 until required link/status bits are set for each enabled instance.
Mark progress by writing 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100 and wait.

For each enabled instance: read initial configuration DWORDs; probe BAR-related offsets by writing all-ones and reading back; program BAR offsets with specified values; enable Memory, IO, and Bus Master in the Command register.
Poll 0xE6004100 until it reads 0x12345678 to confirm completion.
Declare the test PASS and terminate.
test_items.expected_results: SII status indicates link/status bits are set; configuration-space accesses complete; final handshake value 0x12345678 is observed at 0xE6004100.
test_items.pass_criteria: The test reaches finish(0) after the handshake register becomes 0x12345678 and link/status conditions were satisfied during polling.

dependencies: Requires pcie.h and test_common.h support APIs; requires link training and memory base programming helpers; external agent for final handshake write.
data_requirements: External write of 0x12345678 to address 0xE6004100 to release the final wait loop.
exit_criteria: Completion of all steps and observation of handshake value 0x12345678; absence of stuck polling loops.
reporting: Console prints active when DEBUG_DISPLAY is enabled; otherwise silent completion with finish(0).
